features.name: Manifest Echo
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you create an echo of yourself within 15 feet (AC 14 + your Proficiency Bonus, 1 Hit Point). You can attack from its position, swap places with it for 15 feet of movement, and make Opportunity Attacks from it.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, you can make one extra melee attack from the echo's position (a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier).

features.name: Echo Avatar
features.desc: As an action, you project your consciousness into the echo, seeing and hearing through its senses (while you are Deafened and Blinded); the echo can move up to 1,000 feet away, for up to 10 minutes.

features.name: Echo Avatar
features.desc: As a Reaction, you teleport the echo into the path of an attack aimed at another creature; the attack targets the echo instead. Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Reclaim Potential
features.desc: When the echo is destroyed by damage, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 + your Constitution modifier (a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier).

features.name: Legion of One
features.desc: You can have two echoes at once; when you roll Initiative and have no uses of Unleash Incarnation left, you regain one.
